ValidationRule.description: Tax rate must be sub-50%, discount cannot exceed the larger of 30% of amount and 1000, and tax-inclusive total (rounded to cents) must be positive.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Amount__c)), OR( NULLVALUE(Tax_Rate__c, 0) >= 0.5, NULLVALUE(Discount__c, 0) > MAX(0.3 * Amount__c, 1000), ROUND(Amount__c * (1 + NULLVALUE(Tax_Rate__c, 0)) - NULLVALUE(Discount__c, 0), 2) <= 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Tax or discount makes the invoice total invalid.
